# Inspect Note
Use the current task assignment and provenance to identify scope. If assigned as a qualified reviewer for this request, directly compare the note with original requirements and report evidence-backed omissions. A coordinating context fills missing independent review capacity. An author context obtains an independent judgment; current-round qualified reviewers execute their assigned work. Follow any explicit request for a new comprehensive opinion.
